GRD-0099 covered only the in-memory signal race at dispatch, so accepted durable CANCELLING state still had no backstop while a long sandbox activity was in flight; this repeat is a GUARDRAIL_FAILURE. Separately, detached checkpoint validation modeled sealed tags only and could not validate an exact IN_PROGRESS subject without prematurely creating its seal tag. notes: The failed complete run remains authoritative. The evaluator suite and detached-subject regressions are green, but the LSN-0098 recurrence remains an unresolved GUARDRAIL_FAILURE until the new durable-state guard passes a live checkout-owned cancellation scenario; another complete verifier is still mandatory after that focused proof.

trigger: Focused checkout-owned live reproduction of the unresolved LSN-0098 guardrail failure
rootCauseSummary: The durable poll alone exposed a narrower race: cancellation was already accepted when the sandbox response completed normally, but the workflow attempted to record SUCCEEDED before giving cancellation precedence. The CANCELLING store correctly refused that late result, the workflow exhausted retries, and the run stayed non-terminal. A flag set at the activity-handle handoff could also make the watcher return without cancelling the new handle.
notes: The focused red run is preserved and its isolated project was removed while the shared project stayed unchanged. The repair now cancels an already-flagged new handle and makes accepted cancellation win over a racing normal response before result persistence. The rebuilt evaluator suite passes 68 tests; a new live focused proof and then a complete verifier remain mandatory.
